decisions.choice: Put the stance in the first sentence of each entry. Tie `repin` to the Claude Code pin inside the version-pins sentence, with no '. ' in either first sentence. Later sentences carry scope and the 'Prose-only: no loop code enforces it yet.' marker. Exact text, version-pins: 'Version pins are exact and never auto-floated; only the person running Athena moves one, and the Claude Code pin (`claude_version`) moves through the existing `cargo run -p xtask -- repin` command.' Exact text, hermetic-checks: 'A check never depends on inherited environment or ambient tools; the runner passes every path a check needs, and any preferred-versus-fallback tool choice is recorded in the check output.'
decisions.reason: `first_sentence` cuts at the first '. ' (defaults.rs:77-83), so the reader sees only sentence one. Producer and verifier get the full statement through `get` (briefs.rs:342-349). Tying repin to `claude_version` answers critic finding 2: repin rewrites only that line (xtask/src/main.rs:16, :683, :726-761), while other pins such as rust-toolchain.toml:2 and the ci.yml action SHAs have no command. Criterion 1 reads 'changed only by the person running Athena through the existing repin command'; the sentence meets it for the one pin repin moves and does not overclaim for the rest.

The comment above the producer line no longer claims the reader budget never rises. run_pin_tests.rs:1625 takes the figure from `BudgetSet::Reader.budget()`. The `budget reader` line reads `<computed size> of 2200`. `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` and `the_reader_headroom_rows_equal_the_budget_figures_and_name_shared_files` (budgets.rs:125, :396) pass, as does the `the_reading_brief_carries_the_token_headroom_of_the_reader_and_verifier_sets` test (run_pin_tests.rs:1581). The computed size is estimated at about 2156 until measured, and `check_budget` returns an error above 2200.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff. Then run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test backtest`, `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test buy_first`. Do not cite a result without running them.
demonstrations.observes: The decisions.md diff is additions only, at the end after D180's last line. It adds `## D181 · …` with Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and `- **Provenance:**` bullets. The Provenance bullet names the root cause (defaults.toml was silent on version-pin and ambient-tool policy), jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q, the retry of 20261114-012353-pbvc, the measured reader size, and says the entry departs from D170's rule that budgets never rise to fit a set, with D93 as precedent. D181 also names the pages.yml floating tags as a known gap and proposes a follow-up job. It contains no 'amends', 'supersedes' or 'superseded by'. The CHANGELOG diff is one added entry at the top of Unreleased/Added. It names the same root cause, the budget raise from 2000 to 2200, D181, and that `cargo run -p xtask -- repin` already exists (D154). No repin code is added and no xtask path is in `git diff --stat`.

demonstrations.method: Add the test to `mod tests` in crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs. It runs `DefaultsModel::parse(REPO_DEFAULTS)` and gets `version-pins` and `hermetic-checks` by id. It asserts applies_to `[code, config, build]` and `[code, config, build, tests]`. It asserts the pins statement contains 'exact', 'never auto-floated', 'repin' and 'Claude Code pin (`claude_version`)'. It asserts the hermetic statement contains 'ambient', 'inherited environment', 'every path' and 'preferred-versus-fallback'. It asserts both full statements contain 'Prose-only'. It asserts that `model.render()` contains both exact lines `- version-pins [code, config, build]: <first sentence>\n` and `- hermetic-checks [code, config, build, tests]: <first sentence>\n`. Then run the targeted test, `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets`, `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib run_pin_tests`, `cargo test --locked -p xtask --test policy`, `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test backtest`, and finally the whole suite with `cargo test --locked`.
demonstrations.observes: The new test passes. The budgets, run_pin_tests headroom, boundary-scan and backtest tests also pass, and the whole `cargo test --locked` passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree defaults.toml has neither id, so the first `model.get("version-pins").unwrap()` panics and the test fails. If a first sentence held a '. ', or the stance sat after the first sentence, `render()` would print a shorter line and the exact-line assertions would fail. If the version-pins sentence claimed repin for every pin, the exact-line assertion would not match the agreed text.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `DefaultsModel::parse` (defaults.rs:36) and `DefaultsModel::render` (defaults.rs:58). Guards: `deny_unknown_fields` (defaults.rs:7, :16), the duplicate-id check (:41) and the empty statement or source check (:44). The fixture is `REPO_DEFAULTS = include_str!("../../../defaults.toml")` at defaults.rs:89, the real file with no double. The seam exists today. The plan adds only the test (step 2). `render` is the text the reader loads (reading.rs:241-253 `reader_system_prompt`, and budgets.rs:34-39).

demonstrations.method: Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. Recorded checks on the final tree (fmt, clippy, test) also count.
demonstrations.observes: Both commands exit 0 with no diff and no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: A badly formatted new test or the reworded comment would fail `cargo fmt --all --check`. An unused import or a needless borrow in the changed `format!` call in run_pin_tests.rs would fail clippy.
demonstrations.seam: The cargo commands are the production checks Athena runs (the 'Checks Athena will run' list). No fixture is used. The seam exists.
